name: cuda-sparse-human-cell-scaling-v1
purpose: Test the >100,000-active-cell and >100 end-to-end recurrent tokens/s engineering gate on an exact persistent-device CUDA backend.
notes: One token is exactly 100 fitted 0.05-ms GLIF5 integration steps.
One cooperative CUDA launch executes the full token interval.
Reverse CSR preserves CPU scatter order independently for every postsynaptic cell.
End-to-end time includes synchronous download of every mutable cell and synapse array.
The three-factor readout setting prevents allocation of the ridge N-by-N normal matrix.
Final timing is valid only in an isolated GPU window; utilization snapshots are recorded.
